issues.description: Interface naming mismatch: the problem statement and template refer to an interface named 'Rideable' with an abstract method messageOnRide(), but the solution repository defines an interface named 'Mountable' (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Mountable.java) and has Pig and Seal implement Mountable. Meanwhile src/de/tum/cit/ase/Rideable.java in the solution is effectively empty. This inconsistent naming (Rideable vs Mountable) means code and tests expecting Rideable will not find the expected interface or implementations, and students will be confused which interface name to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across all artifacts. Preferred fixes: (A) Rename the solution's Mountable interface to Rideable (move or copy the messageOnRide() signature into src/de/tum/cit/ase/Rideable.java or replace Rideable.java with the correct interface) and update Pig.java and Seal.java to implement Rideable, or (B) change the problem statement and template to use 'Mountable' consistently and remove/replace the empty Rideable.java. Ensure the final interface file contains: public interface Rideable { String messageOnRide(); } so tests and template code compile.
